name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule ('If you pick up the key, you must also open the door'). has_door_key is an if-condition, not a goal, so no Existence is warranted; the hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) captures it, and door_open may come before or after the key. The rule-only warning is expected and valid.

texts: If has_door_key happens, door_open must also happen.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
